mapper.select: SELECT id,product_name_snapshot,paid_amount FROM ledger_entry WHERE id=#{p.id} AND entry_type='EXPENSE' AND lifecycle_status='ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE
SELECT COALESCE(sum(amount),0) FROM expense_adjustment WHERE original_expense_id=#{p.id} AND status='EFFECTIVE'

SELECT a.id,a.original_expense_id,l.product_name_snapshot,a.adjustment_type,a.amount, a.business_time,a.business_date,a.status,a.note,l.paid_amount, (SELECT COALESCE(sum(active.amount),0) FROM expense_adjustment active WHERE active.original_expense_id=a.original_expense_id AND active.status='EFFECTIVE') AS effective_total, a.created_at,a.updated_at,a.version FROM expense_adjustment a JOIN ledger_entry l ON l.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND l.id=a.original_expense_id WHERE a.id=#{p.id}
